answer: We thwart autonomous Sybil attacks by deploying recursive zero-knowledge commitments in a karst architecture, rendering agent spoofing infeasible via information-theoretic unforgeability. By mandating staking collateral vulnerable to severe slashing penalties, systems restrict attackers through a narrow inlet of bounded risk, yielding negative expected attack utility. This cryptoeconomic model yields a robust Nash equilibrium, where sequential delay functions act as an immovable glacier to enforce Byzantine fault-tolerant cryptographic finality.
